_comment: Qwen Code project settings for the transboarded project root. Hook commands are project-root relative and reuse the shared .agentic/hooks/ guards used by the Codex, Claude Code, Pi, and OpenCode adapters.
_comment_context: AGENTS.md stays the authoritative workflow contract; QWEN.md is only the Qwen adapter note. Both are loaded as context files, AGENTS.md first.
_comment_permissions: Outward delivery (git push, gh pr create, git merge) is denied by default and also gated by the delivery-preflight hook; a human runs those actions after preflight passes. Secret and key files are denied for read and write to mirror the Claude and Codex filesystem profiles.
